Time Tracking is where your crew clock in and out against a job.
It works on a phone, so it happens on the site instead of being reconstructed from memory on Friday afternoon.
Pick the project — nearby ones come up first — and clock in.
The hours land as labor cost on the job they were worked on, which is the piece most trade businesses are missing when they try to work out what a job really made.
The Time Dashboard totals it all by person and by project.
